# Pelthos Therapeutics to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 12, 2026


November 04, 2026 4:05pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_e8e1c9a287e3be5a387ab5bf8fa52f4e/pelthos/news/2026-11-04_Pelthos_Therapeutics_to_Report_Third_Quarter_2026__66.pdf)


### Company to hold a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET


DURHAM, N.C., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pelthos Therapeutics Inc. (NYSE American: PTHS), a biopharmaceutical company committed to commercializing innovative therapeutic products for unmet patient needs (“Pelthos”), today announced it will report third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The company will hold a conference call followed by a question-and-answer period at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time.


Details for the conference call can be found below:


Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026


Time: 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time


Toll Free: 1-877-451-6152


International: 1-201-389-0879

**About Pelthos Therapeutics**
Pelthos Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on building and advancing a portfolio of differentiated cutaneous infectious disease products that address unmet patient needs. ZELSUVMI® (berdazimer) topical gel, 10.3%, the company’s lead product, is the first and only prescription therapy approved for use at home by patients, parents, and caregivers to treat molluscum contagiosum. The company’s portfolio of assets includes XEPI® (ozenoxacin) Cream, 1%, a topical treatment for impetigo, and XEGLYZE® (abametapir), a topical treatment for head lice.
